    VGO Emulator client and confirmed them. They may be exactly right, they may
    carry figures the game never used, or they may not be in the emulator at

      115 have had their tooltip read in game.
    
    Where a tooltip has been read it overrides the wikis, and around four in
    five disagreed with them — so treat the figures below with care.

Ashen Hand I

Monk · Level 8 · Harmonoius Body

Effect

Unleashes a burst of Jin in the form of a single powerful attack that inflicts 200% weapon damage plus 38 to 44.

Ranks

RankLevelCostEffect
I 2 {{Jin|6}} 200% weapon damage plus 14 to 17

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.

2 — now 8
Unleashes a burst of Jin in the form of a single powerful attack that inflicts 400% weapon damage plus 26 to 32. Cost: Submit Info Cast Time: Submit Info Refresh: Submit Info Range: Submit Info

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

Debuff: Vulnerable Soul Wracked

The level recorded here was read from the VGO Emulator client. the vanguardmonks.com ability table, captured in 2008 gives a different one, and it is not an error in either: that page describes the game as it stood in 2007 and the emulator runs a much later build, so the Monk's abilities were rebalanced between the two. Forty of the Monk's abilities differ this way.

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.
